_comment: What nix/checks/studio-manifest.nix accepts as NOT a game artifact.
`tools` are packages with no kiln record that are not meant to have one:
toolchains, libraries, emulators, images and standalone assets. A name
matches if it equals an entry, or starts with an entry ending in '-'.
`examples_without_rom` are directories under examples/ that are not built
as a ROM. Adding to either list is a statement that the studio should not
show the thing as a game; say why in the commit.
